close_reason: Fixed: hoisted has_on_success before the pre-fetch block; removed duplicate computation at previous line 539.
description: submission.rs: has_on_success is computed inside an unnamed {} block (L359-366) and then identically recomputed outside it (L526-533). The inner variable is dead the moment the block closes. Fix: hoist has_on_success before the unnamed block (or remove the block) so the single binding is reused both times.
title: has_on_success computed twice in handle_submission_set
